 Chris Evans Offer Clears Answer to if He’s Playing Captain America in Avengers: Doomsday
 Christie D'Silva 2026년 11월 17일 화 오후 9:36 UTC 0 Photo Credit - Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures Chris Evans ‘ return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe has many fans excited for the upcoming Avengers movie. However, Marvel has not yet clarified whether Evans would reprise his role as Captain America or return as Steve Rogers.
 In an interview with Empire Magazine , Evans was asked about the absence of the words “Captain America” in discussions about his return. In response, the actor clarified his role in the upcoming movie. Chris said, “Steve is just Steve. Steve is not Captain America in this movie. That’s [Anthony] Mackie.”
 During the interview, Evans also revealed that he was reluctant to return to Marvel after the events of Avengers: Endgame. He revealed that the studio executives Kevin Feige and Louis D’Esposito approached him with ideas for Steve’s character as Nomad while they were filming Endgame. However, the actor said that none of the storylines resonated with Steve’s character arc, adding, “I didn’t want to come back unless there was something really meaningful and impactful and unique.”
 Anthony Mackie & Chris Evans’ MCU history as Captain America explained
 As Chris Evans revealed, Avengers: Doomsday will have one Captain America, played by Anthony Mackie. Mackie first appeared in the MCU as Sam Wilson in Captain America: The Winter Soldier, where he met Evans’ Steve Rogers and became one of his closest allies. In the movie, Sam secures a pair of mechanical wings and, as the Falcon, fights alongside Steve against Hydra.
 Advertisement
 The duo continued fighting together as Falcon and Captain America in Civil War, Avengers: Infinity War, and then in Endgame. However, at the end of the Infinity Saga, Steve returns as an old man after going back in time and living his life with Peggy Carter. During this event, he hands his shield over to Sam, thereby passing the role of Captain America to his friend. 
 While Steve Rogers’ journey ended in Endgame, Sam Wilson became the focus in the Disney+ series The Falcon and the Winter Soldier, where he accepts the mantle and officially becomes Captain America. He later led his own movie, Captain America: Brave New World, further establishing his role in the MCU. In the upcoming Avengers film, Sam will reportedly lead the Avengers to fight Doctor Doom .
 Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to release in theaters on December 18, 2026.
 Originally reported on SuperHeroHype .
